description: This file defines a Filter class for parsing and matching test case filters based on various criteria such as project, status, text, labels, and annotations. It includes methods for parsing filter expressions, tokenizing input, and matching test case summaries against filters.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: A class for creating, parsing, and applying filters to test case summaries based on multiple criteria.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the filter has any criteria set.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a filter expression string into a Filter object with criteria.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Determines if a given test case summary matches the filter criteria.
